initial_conditions: Start with an empty project and original flat meshes. The two-slot pocket uses millimetres and Harbor uses metres.
actions: Import the two-slot mesh through the combined native studio, choose millimetres, save and reopen the project, select a cutout and export OBJ.
Replay the earlier physical corner edit and two-fabric Harbor import against the integrated release CLI.
Exercise file and inline imports through the official MCP SDK and verify destination files after rejection.
expected_outcomes: The pocket retains two editable openings, 0.240 × 0.360 m dimensions, 0.0756 m² material area and a 1.74 m boundary. Moving one cutout corner by 20 mm reduces the area to 0.0744 m². Harbor retains its two colors and placed panel outlines.
